raw_input: Sunrise Yoga Studio, single location in Austin TX, owner-operated by founder Kelly Nguyen. 8 instructors, ~200 active members. Owner posted on LinkedIn about wanting to grow membership past 300 but struggling with marketing.
Kinetic Physical Therapy, 2 locations in Denver metro. Owned by Dr. Rajesh Patel. 12 clinicians. 4.9 stars on Google with 400+ reviews. Owner mentioned in a podcast that ops are eating his time.
Bodhi Pilates, 3 studios across Portland OR. Owner Sarah Chen, 6 instructors per studio. Recently posted a job for a marketing coordinator on Indeed.
